text: Adoption of the City of Toronto's updated Use of City Resources During an Election Period Policy is proposed.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted, as Toronto Atmospheric Fund's policy, the most recent City of Toronto Use of City Resources During and Election Period, as approved by City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018. 2. Received for information the Interpretation Bulletin - Code of Conduct for Members of Local Boards (April 24, 2018) from the Integrity Commissioner.
